topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: What sort of trick is this, bringing flowers with no word, no note to say who sent them? It’s a waste, that’s what it is.谁能有这闲工夫，弄得这么神秘？ Fields don’t plant themselves, and the rent doesn’t pay itself. The saints know we’ve got better things to do than puzzle over such nonsense. I’ve got to watch the sky, pray for rain, and make sure the soil isn’t too dry to plant. These flowers mean nothing when the crops could fail. Enough of this foolishness, I say. Back to the fields with me, where the work is real and the rewards are earned.
